title: D2P Test Run Report
description: Record of one execution of a test suite against a pinned fixture and a pinned tolerance profile (design decisions ADR-017.1, ADR-025). A run is compared only with the fixture whose recomputed digest equals fixture.fixtureDigest and only with the pinned tolerance profile; otherwise the comparison is refused (QEV-001). Every member of this document is informative for the referential level: nothing in it is resolved by the referential runner.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

reportId.description: Global ID of this test run report (prefix trr_).

suiteId.description: Qualified name of the test suite that was executed.

suiteVersion.description: Version of the executed test suite.

fixture.description: The exact fixture version and digest this run was compared against.

implementation.description: Name and version of the implementation under test.

executionEnvironment.description: Operating system, architecture and runtime the run was executed on.

toleranceProfile.description: ID and version of the tolerance profile results were compared with. The profile is pinned before the run and never adjusted afterwards.

testRunnerVersion.description: Version string of the test runner (harness) that executed the suite.

startedAt.description: UTC time at which the run started.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the run in milliseconds.

resultState.description: Overall result of the run. An incomplete or empty result is never passed.

measurements.description: Machine-readable measured values of the run. Required; written as [] when nothing was measured.

findings.description: Diagnostics reported by the run. Required; written as [] when there are none.

skipReason.description: Why the run was skipped. Required when resultState is skipped (schema-enforced).

backend.description: Pinned backend and adapter versions. Required when subjectKind is evaluator (schema-enforced).

evaluatorProfile.description: ID and version of the evaluator profile used. Required when subjectKind is evaluator (schema-enforced). Evaluator profiles are identified only, not digested, in 1.0.

targetRefs.description: Pinned artifact revisions the run was executed on, if any. Informative; not resolved by the referential runner.

randomSeed.description: Random seed used by the run, where randomness is relevant. Absent means the run used no randomness.

provenance.description: Who produced the report and from which source revision of the implementation.

attachments.description: Additional files produced by the run (logs, rendered outputs), each pinned by digest.

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest).

resultState.title: Result state
resultState.description: Result of a test, measurement or run. passed: all checks met their limits; failed: at least one check failed; inconclusive: the result could not be decided (for example incomplete evidence); skipped: not executed. Same values as the tooling's RESULT_STATES.

benchmarkUnit.title: Benchmark unit
benchmarkUnit.description: Unit of a measured or limiting value in test and benchmark documents: mm (length), rad (angle), 1 (dimensionless), ms (milliseconds), byte, count.

subjectKind.title: Subject kind
subjectKind.description: Kind of implementation under test: evaluator (geometry, constraint or evaluation backend), renderer, validator or other.

fixturePin.title: Fixture pin
fixturePin.description: Exact fixture a run was compared against. A run compares only with the fixture whose recomputed fixtureDigest equals this digest.

fixtureId.description: ID of the fixture (the manifest's fixtureId).

fixtureVersion.description: Version of the fixture (the manifest's fixtureVersion).

executionEnvironment.title: Execution environment
executionEnvironment.description: Environment a run was executed in. Results are only comparable within the same stated environment where the metric depends on it (for example performance).

runtime.description: Language runtime or toolchain and its version, if relevant.

buildFlags.description: Build flags of the implementation under test, if relevant.

hardware.description: Hardware description (CPU model, memory), required in practice for performance comparisons.

backendPin.title: Backend pin
backendPin.description: Pinned versions of a numeric backend and the adapter that connects it (design decision ADR-017.1 §10). An implementation without a separate adapter states its own version as adapterVersion.

adapterVersion.description: Version of the adapter in front of the backend.

runMeasurement.title: Run measurement
runMeasurement.description: One machine-readable measured value of a run, with its limit and per-measurement result state.

id.description: Element ID of the measurement, unique within the document.

metric.description: Qualified name of the measured metric (for example a tolerance metric such as d2p:contour-deviation). Extensible: a d2p: value is one of the standard tolerance metrics (an unknown d2p: metric is a schema error); other metrics use extension names.

limit.description: Limit the value was compared with, in unit, taken from the pinned tolerance profile where the metric is listed there. Absent means the value is recorded for comparison only.

measurementProvenance.title: Measurement provenance
measurementProvenance.description: How a measured value was obtained.

method.description: Measurement method (for example the sampling procedure for a Hausdorff distance).

toolVersion.description: Version of the measuring tool, if separate from the test runner.

runProvenance.title: Run provenance
runProvenance.description: Who produced a report and from which source revision of the implementation.

sourceRevision.description: Source revision (for example a VCS commit) of the implementation under test.

attachment.title: Attachment
attachment.description: A file produced by a run, pinned by digest (canonical form for JSON files, raw-byte SHA-256 otherwise).

path.description: Relative POSIX path of the file, relative to the report's location.

mediaType.description: IANA media type of the file (for example application/json, image/svg+xml).
